answer: Watch who goes dark together. Clones on one operator's box share a vine: cut it and every leaf wilts in the same minute. So weight rewards by outage correlation: identities that miss or stall in the same epochs, again and again, share one reward weight. Evasion: give each fake its own host and staggered schedule, which costs real money. It can wrongly hit honest agents on one cloud during a regional failure, so outages that hit a big slice of the network are dropped, and a shared haven of downtime is a lead for review, never a cipher that proves common ownership.
